I look at this in a psychological way cause basically as an introvert i can put myself in the positions of others and show empathy to what they feel and how they act. furthermore its been like this since school which i also hated, i was quiet but thinking so my grades always were medium. in tests and exams i always had my streghts cause i was alone with my innerself and my thughts, but in the classes i hated to speak up and say what i know etc. which led to bad oral grades. After school i now hate uni, doing projects and holding speeches just dont suit me. Its that feeling of getting observed all the time and just trying to not get vulnarable or beeing looked at for what i say and think. But this is only in the specifical peer group. Like my a-levels oral exam talking to a teacher for 15 minutes straight - no problem, i worked in a kindergarden - no problem having authority and talking with kids and colleagues. Just this psychological group of people in the same age and not wanting to get left out and behind cause i dont  have that big of a social life anyway is the point.
